scope: Synthetic trapped harmonic particle graphs; implementation only until GPU tests and calibration pass. Not MOF or adsorption validation, and not a reproduction of FEAT's published molecular results.
selection: Fixed final checkpoint; no hyperparameter search or test-driven model selection.
primary_metric: Mean absolute error of delta F in kBT units on disjoint four-node graphs; six-node graphs are a separate size-OOD result.
comparability: The two neural arms share graphs, width, depth, updates and optimizer but NOT labels, parameter count, or inference cost. Ordinary GNN uses analytic training delta-F labels; FEAT uses independent equilibrium endpoint samples and exact endpoint energies at inference. Mean-work ablation uses exactly the same FEAT network and paths.
